lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the gills, with primary nodes forming roughly parallel rows along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes especially visible in the central and posterior flank regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition with light-saturated pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow-defined pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 8 to 10 high-luminance blobs strictly contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, localized primarily near the base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a high-density distribution of micro-blobs that are significantly smaller in diameter and more concentrated than the macro-blobs on the main flank.
